Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Boiler Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Boiler Services specializes in the installation and repair of residential and light commercial boiler and furnace systems. Our operations focus on providing safe, efficient, and compliant services, adhering strictly to local building codes and safety regulations. We utilize experienced technicians who are trained in OSHA compliance and equipped with the necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) to ensure worker safety. Our commitment to quality includes regular maintenance of our equipment and a proactive approach to risk management. We engage specialized subcontractors for certain tasks, ensuring all contracts include appropriate indemnification clauses and that subcontractors maintain adequate insurance coverage. Additionally, we offer ancillary services, including the installation of carbon monoxide detectors and chemical treatments for boiler systems, all while upholding strict environmental and regulatory compliance. Our clean claims history reflects our dedication to safety and excellence in the industry.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 10, 2023, a claim was filed for water damage caused by a faulty pressure relief valve during a routine boiler maintenance check. The total cost for repairs amounted to $2,000. The claim is currently closed, having been resolved without further issues.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Fully enclosed perimeter fencing with monitored security system and regular on-site inspections by trained personnel.
